entities.text: ADDITIONAL MOTOR ACCIDENT CLAIMS TRIBUNAL, RANEBENNUR
entities.label: PETITIONER

sentences.text: This appeal is filed by the NWKRTC challenging the judgment and award dated 19.10.2011 passed by the tribunal, in MVC No.511/2010, questioning the quantum of compensation.
2. The factum of accident, injuries sustained by the claimant in the accident, coverage of insurance are not disputed in this case.
3. Heard the arguments and perused the material placed before the Court.

4. The tribunal has awarded compensation of Rs.1,85,500/- along with interest at the rate of 6% p.a.
from the date of petition till realization.
The claimant has suffered comminuted fracture of right leg femur.
The claimant is a senior citizen of 74 years old as on the date of accident.
The tribunal has taken monthly income at Rs.3,000/- per month.
The accident occurred on 10.09.2009.

By considering the year of accident, in the absence of proof of income, the notional income would have to be taken at Rs.5,000/- per month as recognized by the Karnataka State Legal Service Authority.
Further more, the doctor has stated that the claimant has suffered 50% of physical disability, but the tribunal is correct in holding 25% as functional disability towards whole body.
The claimant is petty businessman of aged 74 years.
Therefore, considering the income taken by the tribunal is on lower side, if the monthly income of Rs.5,000/- was taken, then the compensation ought to have been more.

sentences.text: Further more, considering the quantum of compensation awarded under other heads is found to be little more.
The fracture is comminuted fracture
. Hence, by NC: 2023:KHC-D:13262 considering the overall facts and circumstances involved in the case, the compensation awarded by the tribunal is just and proper which needs no interference.
Therefore, the appeal is liable to be dismissed.

7. In the result, I proceed to pass the following:
ORDER i) The appeal is dismissed.
ii) The judgment and award dated 19.10.2011 passed by the Prl. Senior Civil Judge and Addl. MACT, Ranebennur, in MVC No.511/2010, is confirmed.
iii) The amount in deposit shall be transmitted to the tribunal.
iv) No order as to costs.
